mapper.select: SELECT r.side, r.speaker_client_id, r.speaker_name, m.content FROM ai_debate_record r LEFT JOIN ai_chat_room_message m ON r.message_id = m.message_id WHERE r.session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.round_number = #{roundNumber} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.turn_number ASC

SELECT id, record_id, session_id, room_id, round_number, turn_number, speaker_client_id, speaker_name, side, message_id, arbitrator_reasoning, is_deleted, create_time FROM ai_debate_record WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND round_number = #{roundNumber} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY turn_number ASC

SELECT id, record_id, session_id, room_id, round_number, turn_number, speaker_client_id, speaker_name, side, message_id, arbitrator_reasoning, is_deleted, create_time FROM ai_debate_record WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY round_number DESC, turn_number DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: UPDATE ai_debate_record SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
